sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) FROM crossing_points c JOIN islands i ON ST_DWithin(c.geom, i.geom, 4174) WHERE i.id = 85 AND c.id < 1000000000000 GROUP BY i.id

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS crossing_count
FROM crossing_points c
GLOBAL JOIN islands i ON i.id = 85
WHERE c.h3 GLOBAL IN (SELECT arrayJoin(h3CoverRing(arrayElement(geom.Polygon, 1), 4174)) FROM islands WHERE id = 85 AND variantType(geom) = 'Polygon' UNION ALL SELECT arrayJoin(h3CoverLine(geom.LineString, 4174)) FROM islands WHERE id = 85 AND variantType(geom) = 'LineString')
  AND if(variantType(i.geom) = 'LineString',
         arrayMin(arrayMap((a, b) -> sqrt(pow(c.x - (a.1 + (b.1 - a.1) * greatest(0., least(1., ((c.x - a.1) * (b.1 - a.1) + (c.y - a.2) * (b.2 - a.2)) / greatest(pow(b.1 - a.1, 2) + pow(b.2 - a.2, 2), 1e-9)))), 2)
                                        + pow(c.y - (a.2 + (b.2 - a.2) * greatest(0., least(1., ((c.x - a.1) * (b.1 - a.1) + (c.y - a.2) * (b.2 - a.2)) / greatest(pow(b.1 - a.1, 2) + pow(b.2 - a.2, 2), 1e-9)))), 2)),
                           arrayPopBack(arrayMap(pt -> tuple(6378137. * radians(pt.1), 6378137. * log(tan(pi() / 4 + radians(pt.2) / 2))), i.geom.LineString)), arrayPopFront(arrayMap(pt -> tuple(6378137. * radians(pt.1), 6378137. * log(tan(pi() / 4 + radians(pt.2) / 2))), i.geom.LineString)))),
         polygonsDistanceCartesian(array(array(tuple(c.x, c.y))),
           arrayMap(ring -> arrayMap(pt -> tuple(6378137. * radians(pt.1), 6378137. * log(tan(pi() / 4 + radians(pt.2) / 2))), ring), i.geom.Polygon))
     ) <= 4174
  AND c.id > 0 AND c.id < 1000000000000
